info.title: Hotel System API
info.description: Implemented same-origin API for health, polling, table tablets, kiosks, kitchen displays and collection displays. Server sessions derive staff/device/guest scope; clients cannot select those identities.

servers.description: Same-origin installation API; production uses HTTPS.
